payload.title: Field telemetry and README Proof section
payload.body:
Field recording (one content-free cli run event per command), the opt-in PostHog EU telemetry adapter (tasks telemetry status|on|off|send --dry-run), and a generated README Proof section from docs/proof/metrics.json. Folds in PR #40.
- **Hypothesis**: real-use totals replace not-measured-yet rows in the README Proof section
- **Success**: 2 or more machines in the Proof table within 2 weeks of the key being set
- **Pivot**: PostHog free tier cannot give per-event totals, then a private git repo of aggregates
- **Measurement**: node scripts/proof.mjs record && node scripts/proof.mjs check
- **Anchor**: Homebrew analytics (docs.brew.sh/Analytics), anonymous usage counts
